title: Tantalum Based High-Pressure Cold Spray Coatings on Stainless Steel Substrate
InformationInFigures: Yes. Fig. 1 morphology and size of Ta powder

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: grinded at 400, 800, and 1200 grit size SiC abrasive papers. Specimens are then fine polished using 1 μm diamond paste and finally with colloidal silica, followed by etching using a diluted solution of 30 ml distillated water, 20 ml HCl and 15 ml HNO3

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: very dense and homogeneous flow of material shear present, confirmed by good bond formed purely of mechanical interlocking with no detectable chemical interaction present at the interface. no intermediate or phase formation

Experiments.Notes: Sample 1.1.1. in the intro it says this work uses AISI 1018 carbon steel but in the procedure it says 316L stainless steel so I went with that. Hardness is also given as 3.98 GPa.
